second_method.method: printed difficulty distribution table (per division, summed)

count_gate.note: 4-division composite; 140 q. printed difficulty tables (summed) 121/13/6=140; per-question tags 120/14/6 (total 140 AGREES); Mysore q42 table=Easy vs tag=Average -> tags win (v2 §6), register difficulty-table-vs-tags. 4 division answer maps (answer_diagram; Kalaburagi labels Kannada->translated). flagged = 3 match-key-inconsistent + 4 map diagrams. all carry the structural marks flag.

method_notes: Composite chapter (v1.4 §14.2): 4 divisions (Bengaluru/Mysore/Kalaburagi/Belagavi), numbering restarts per division. sections -sN- across the WHOLE chapter (s1-4 Bengaluru, s5-8 Mysore, s9-12 Kalaburagi, s13-16 Belagavi); id suffix = division ordinal (div1 '', div2 'b', div3 'c', div4 'd'); section_signal 'Division/Roman'.
No MCQ in this chapter. Section forms: I fill, II one-sentence vsa, III match (section-header '(Average)'), IV two-to-four-sentence sa (incl the division map-draw, appended by add_maps_03).

Matches: div1 q26 & div2 q29 print their number question-side; div3 q32 & div4 q27 do NOT (section III has no printed number) -> number inferred from the division difficulty table; question locator y=0 (missing_y, structural).
Section-header difficulty (v1.4 §14.7): each division's section III match = 'average' (difficulty_source section_header). All other questions carry inline tags.
DIFFICULTY-TABLE-VS-TAGS: Mysore q42 printed table lists Easy but stem tag is (Average) -> tags win (v2 §6). Chapter per-q tags 120/14/6 vs summed tables 121/13/6 (q42 swap). Register.

Match-key notes (assert printed verbatim + flag): div1 q26 pair4 'Bird Sanctuary' (col-B e = Vulture Conservation Centre); div2 q29 pair7 'Karnataka Government Drama Institution' (col-B d = Karnataka State Repertory); div4 q27 pair2 'Ravike' (col-B d = Blouse). div3 q32 consistent.
No Kannada stored (v1.4 §14.12); romanised names only. MARKS: none printed (addendum §4.5).
